senses.gloss: ऐश्वर mf(ई)n. (fr. ईश्वर), relating to or coming from a mighty lord or king, mighty powerful, majestic, MBh.; BhP.; Kathās. &c.
belonging to or coming from Śiva, Ragh. xi, 76; Kathās. cxvi, 10
ऐश्वर n. supremacy, power, might, BhP. x
ऐश्वरी f. N. of Durgā, T.
ऐश्वरि m. a descendant of Īśvara, N. of a Ṛṣi.
ऐश्वरकारणिक m. a theist of the Nyāya school, Hcar.
ऐश्वरिक N. of one of the 4 philosophical systems in Nepāl (the other 3 being कार्मिक, यात्निक, and स्वाभाविक), Buddh. (cf. MWB. 204).
ऐ॑श्वर्य n. the state of being a mighty lord, sovereignty, supremacy, power, sway, ŚBr. xiii; MBh.; Mn. &c.

superhuman power (either perpetual or transient, consisting, according to some, of the following eight: अणिमन्, लघिमन्, महिमन्, प्राप्ति, प्राकाम्य, वशित्व, ईशित्व, and कामावसायित्व, qq.v.; or, according to others, of such powers as vision, audition, cogitation, discrimination, and omniscience; and of active powers such as swiftness of thought, power of assuming forms at will, and faculty of expatiation, Sarvad. &c.)
ऐश्वर्य-कादम्बिनी f. N. of a poem in praise of Kṛṣṇa by Vidyā-bhūṣaṇa.
ऐश्वर्य—वत् mfn. possessing power or supremacy, MBh.
possessed of or connected with superhuman powers.
